content: The rockslide clears on the morning of day 5. It's currently day 1, 10:48. I need to wait until day 5 morning. Let me record this fact and wait.

args.lesson: In Meadow, the north pass to the Old Shrine Chest (11,1) is blocked by a Rockslide at (11,4) until the morning of day 5; the notice board at (3,7) says the repair crew clears it then.
